purpose: Track recent formal Prism review degradation so resource-limited outcomes stay visible instead of being mistaken for full multi-agent quorum.

visible_actions.healthy: 当前降级率处于健康区间；继续使用正常 Prism 验收门，并保持状态面展示。
visible_actions.warning: 在状态和诊断中显示 warning；下一次正式 Prism 前优先做更强的 provider 健康嗅探。
visible_actions.action_required: 在声明 Prism 健康正常之前，必须打开或选定一个 Prism 可靠性治理任务。

protected_provider_rules: Copilot remains protected fallback and should only be used when Claude Code and Kimi are unavailable.
Codex CLI remains last-resort fallback and should not be used for normal Prism review while non-Codex providers are available.
